events.title: Adding New Official Group - HF Member Role
events.description: Omniscient is exploring a new role flow for new sign-ups: instead of awaiting-activation → registered, new members would land in an 'HF Member' role. The change targets bot mitigation and may bring new role-tied awards.

events.title: New Banner Ad Position
events.description: Omniscient added a new banner ad slot visible to non-upgraded members, expected to deliver around 200–300 views per day for advertisers.

events.title: Game Concept - DDoS Arena
events.description: Omniscient confirmed the long-discussed DDoS Arena concept for the HF Game is now in active development, with early gameplay expected in coming weeks.

events.title: Awards
events.description: King Decade awarded to wiz, 444, Sift, NewGeek, Unknown, Weekend Offender, and Grand Hustle.

events.title: [Tutorial] Snapchat resolve from phone number
events.description: Sift broke down how Snapchat contact syncing can connect a saved phone number to a visible account, with limitations around linked numbers, discovery settings, and privacy controls — a reminder that phone numbers remain a bridge between identity and social profiles.

events.title: Are you ready for a new era of human understanding?
events.description: Hackers opened a wide-ranging thread on UAPs, plasmoids, hidden propulsion, and government wording — pushing members to look up, think bigger, and stay skeptical at the same time.

events.title: What is the difference?
events.description: Bogoss kicked off a beginner discussion comparing web hacking a decade ago to today — stronger frameworks, Cloudflare, CMS/plugin risks, AI-generated sites, and subtle logic mistakes — making the case that modern web hacking is more about understanding systems than running tools.

events.title: Tails OS Issue
events.description: Lil Buddy ran into a Secure Boot warning on Tails despite Windows updates and disabled Secure Boot. 5chn4pp gave a clear explanation pointing toward BIOS/UEFI updates and Microsoft UEFI CA certificates.

events.title: How do you visit HackForums?
events.description: Charlie Sheen ran a community poll on desktop vs mobile usage, sparking nostalgia about how the mobile experience has evolved compared to the older forum days.

events.title: How to make money with AI?
events.description: Mons asked how to move from freelancing into an actual AI business with his AI/data skills, capital, and time. Replies covered content creation, client automation, CI/CD improvements, automated documentation, code review, and turning client data into AI-usable assets.

events.title: $100 USDT Giveaway #2
events.description: Анастасия is hosting a $100 USDT (ERC20) giveaway — entrants share an honest reason why they'd want the prize. Ends May 9.

events.title: Movie of the Week — Ready or Not 2 (2026)
events.description: Charlie Sheen submitted Ready or Not 2 (2026) along with a review thread.
